name: Alkark Terrorjaw [Racial]
body:
Aaaah! Aaaah! AAAAAH! Ker-runch.

Prerequisite(s): Alkark, BAB +7, natural weapons

Benefits: Increase the damage multiplier of your bite attack by 1.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
